pages.text: Mom shaped dough into a ball and put it in a bowl. She covered it with a white towel.
"Leave it alone, and it will grow twice as big." Coco really wanted to see the bigger dough.
Mrs. Magpie came to visit. "Shall we see if it's grown?" She flipped up the towel.
The dough was the same. She put the towel back.
A little later, she lifted it again. "Not yet." Back went the towel.
Lift and cover, lift and cover. The dough wouldn't grow at all.
Mom smiled. "Dough is shy. It grows when no one is looking."
Coco guarded the bowl. Whenever Mrs. Magpie's beak came near, Coco shook their head.
Much later, Coco lifted the towel a little. The dough bulged above the bowl!
"Twice as big!" Mrs. Magpie nodded and nodded. "That's because I didn't look."
